feeds.title: TextileArtist.org
feeds.description: TextileArtist.org is a place for textile and fiber artists to promote their work, be inspired and connect with like-minded creatives. Subscribe to get latest articles from this blog.

feeds.title: Kim's Hot Textiles
feeds.description: Kim is a textile artist, tutor and author of Hot Textiles, featuring Experimental Textiles, Layered Textiles and Reclaimed Textiles. This blog will encourage those who are interested in developing their ideas and experiments in the textile field. Subscribe this blog for exciting exploration of new textile techniques and more.

feeds.title: Gordano Textile Artists
feeds.description: We are a British contemporary textile art group based in Bristol, South Gloucestershire and Somerset. We formed in 1995 to promote stitched textiles as a valid and recognised art form, to keep alive the long tradition of embroidery and to provide mutual support and inspiration to each other.

feeds.title: Fabric Direct
feeds.description: Covers an array of news, views, features and ideas related to various fabrics and accessories that encompass today's fashion trends. Also includes information about fabrics for curtaining, fabrics for dressmaking, fabrics for crafting, fabrics for cosplay and fabrics for any project.

feeds.title: Textile Study Group
feeds.description: The Textile Study Group is a group of nationally and internationally recognised textile artists and tutors, well known for innovative and challenging approaches to art practice and contemporary teaching. The objectives of the group are to cultivate and advance the practice of stitch and textile art through a broad spectrum of education workshops, courses, lectures, publications, exhibitions and to deliver expertise and excellence in all areas of textile art. Subscribe to get latest articles.

feeds.title: Textile Consult | TextileTalk
feeds.description: Consultancy practice for textile professionals, buyers, manufacturers and suppliers to the textile industry! We aim to be the partner of choice for leading textile companies and their partners by supplying industry respected consultancy services and 'best-practice' training programmes. Subscribe to keep up with latest articles from this blog.

feeds.title: InStitches Creative Textile Courses Blog
feeds.description: Stitched yourself into a corner? Fed up with sewing someone else's designs? Need to give your creativity a boost? We may just have the answer you are looking for! InStitches Creative Textile Courses is based on Hampshire/ Berkshire borders, we teach exciting courses to people who love patchwork, quilting, dyeing, stitching and sketchbooks. Subscribe to keep up with latest articles from this blog.

feeds.title: The Textile Blog
feeds.description: This site is a facilitator and general flag waver for the creative arts. Keep up with latest articles and updates by subscribing this blog.

feeds.title: Helen Terry Blog
feeds.description: The blog of Helen Terry, a UK based textile artist, who uses dye, mark-making and stitch to make abstract textile works. This blog tracks her current interests, inspiration and the thinking that lies behind her work. Subscribe to keep up with latest articles from this blog.
